package.name: ur_automata_scan_tsp
package.description: Experimental scan planner: visit order chosen with OR-Tools (TSP or joint TSP over the IK solutions), IK configurations chosen with the layered DP of ur_automata_scan, motions planned with MoveIt 2. Plans once, saves the order and the full trajectory, and replays them in later runs. OR-Tools C++ is not a rosdep key: it is installed from the binary archive in /opt/ortools (see docker/Dockerfile). Without it the package builds nothing.
